options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: shuffle_historia_crux
options.description: Allow randomization of the Historia Crux (entrance rando)

options.name: allow_dlc_items
options.description: Allow DLC items in the pool (requires additional DLC Restoration mod)

options.name: fully_remote_items
options.description: Have Archipelago handle excluded locations instead of filling them locally.

options.name: allow_dlc_locations
options.description: Allow DLC locations to be in scope for Crux randomisation

options.name: fixed_crux_start
options.description:
When using Shuffle Historia Crux, whether or not the starting location(s) should
be fixed to be:
- 0: None
- 1: Bodhum 3AF
- 2: Bodhum 3AF -> Bresha 5AF

Note that when Allow DLC Locations is also enabled, the 3 DLC locations will be
randomised and connected to the initial location even if it is fixed here.
This option is recommended if not using enemy/boss randomisation at the point of
converting the AP generated seed data into the rando modpack.

options.name: win_condition
options.description:
In addition to reaching the end of Academia 500AF, extra conditions can be placed
which will prevent you from accessing the final bosses until they are completed.
- 0: No additional checks
- 1: Fragment Hunt - A minimum number of fragments will be required

options.name: win_condition_fragment_hunt
options.description:
If the win condition is set to "Fragment Count" this controls how many fragments are required

NOTE: Currently game logic does not take this into account at all, so UT may falsely report
"Go Mode" when you do not have enough fragments. Until more (or at least most) of them are in
the pool this will likely not be resolved. Sorry :)

options.name: win_condition_require_final
options.description:
If disabled, victory will be granted once whatever win condition check is cleared at the end of
Academia 500AF.
If enabled, the final bosses must be defeated to win the seed.

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
